subject: Marine Works - Strait of Georgia
text:
Marine Works - Strait of Georgia
Marine Operations in Boundary Passage in the vicinity of 48 45.654N 123 03.673W. Operations include recovery and deployment of under water listening stations, submarine cable laying, ROV operations, crane and subsea lifting.
Hours of operation 24hrs a day, starting 1300UTC Oct 21 ending 1300UTC Oct 25. 

Vessels on site monitoring VHF Ch. 11, 16. 

Requesting minimum wash and 600M CPA.
